name: Hime Hime Booking
source: The main character, an Otaku called Momota, is sitting at home finishing up his latest princess focused eroge as suddenly two little girls show up claiming to be princesses from far away countries. A short time after this Momota receives a message that he's supposed to look after them until they get picked up by their respective guardians.
translation: 主角是一个名叫桃田的御宅族，他正坐在家里完成他最新的以公主为主题的工口游戏，突然两个小女孩出现，自称是来自遥远国家的公主。不久之后，桃田收到一条消息，说他应该照顾他们，直到他们被各自的监护人接走。
